high_level_description: A photorealistic portrait of a fluffy orange tabby cat seated indoors near a window, facing forward in a calm square composition.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A quiet living-room corner with a neutral wall, pale wooden floor, and soft diffused daylight from a nearby window creating even natural illumination across the scene.

elements.desc: Fluffy orange tabby cat, medium size, seated upright and facing forward. Bright green eyes, white whiskers, soft striped orange fur, rounded ears, relaxed alert expression, tail curled around the front paws.
